notes.title: Talvisota Update 1.2.2 Released
notes.content:
We have released the final content update for the Talvisota mod, featuring revamped character models created by a professional artist!

In addition to updating player models and cosmetics, we have also added the following new content for community authors to use in any potential custom maps:

 Early War T-26 with green paint
 Vickers 6 Ton Light Tank
 Finnish Tank Crew role

notes.title: Talvisota Update 1.2.1 Released
notes.content:
We have released a minor update featuring the addition of two community-remastered maps - Ranta and MutarantaKurgan.

If you're having trouble finding a server, in honor of Finland's Independence Day the FLL.fi community is hosting a play session tomorrow Dec 6th, 8pm EET (UTC+2).

notes.title: Talvisota Update 1.2 Released
notes.content:
The second major update is out, featuring four brand-new weapons including the ubiquitous Luger pistol, Bergmann M/20, and the much requested PPD-34.

Also noteworthy is the addition of AI players. Bots were added to Rising Storm 2 with the ARVN update, however they were restricted to offline games only. 
We have removed this restriction only for server seeding, meaning that AI should only be present when the server is empty to help it fill up faster. They automatically get kicked as real players join. 
Server operators, please see the FAQ for more information. 

See the full patchnotes and more details here.

notes.title: Talvisota Update 1.1.1 Released
notes.content:
We have pushed a minor update featuring some improvements to the new map Kiviniemi.
It now has final lighting and visuals, as well as some adjustments to the capture zones. 

Unfortunately due to an unintended side effect of the game engine, we were forced to rebundle ALL the maps, so the download size will be larger than usual. Apologies for the inconvenience. This will not occur frequently.

notes.title: Talvisota Update 1.1 Released
notes.content:
The very first update for the Talvisota Mod has now been released! 

Featuring bugfixes, much-requested QOL changes, and a brand new map: Kiviniemi!
Being the first debut of the map, we are counting on you to play it and give feedback in the Talvisota Discord or Steam Forums!

See the full patchnotes and more details here.
